Setting $\deriv{\varpar}\ell = 0$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
0 &= -\frac{n}{2}\paren{\varpar}^{-1}
 + \frac{1}{2}\paren{\varpar}^{-2}\sumin (x_i - \mean)^2
&& \text{(score for $\varpar$)}\\
\frac{n}{2}\paren{\varpar}^{-1}
&= \frac{1}{2}\paren{\varpar}^{-2}\sumin (x_i - \mean)^2
&& \text{(add $\tfrac{n}{2}(\varpar)^{-1}$)}\\
n\varpar &= \sumin (x_i - \mean)^2
&& \text{(multiply both sides by $2(\varpar)^2$)}\\
\varpar &= \avgin (x_i - \mean)^2
&& \text{(divide both sides by $n$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting the maximizer $\mean = \bar x$,
which does not depend on $\varpar$,
maximizes the [profile log-likelihood](#def-profile-loglik)
of @exm-profile-loglik, and gives:

$$\hsdpar^2_{\text{ML}} = \avgin (x_i - \bar x)^2$$

The profile log-likelihood,
$\ell_p(\varpar) = -\frac{n}{2}\logf{2\pi} - \frac{n}{2}\logf{\varpar} - \frac{n\hvarpar_{\text{ML}}}{2\varpar}$,
increases for $\varpar < \hvarpar_{\text{ML}}$
and decreases for $\varpar > \hvarpar_{\text{ML}}$,
because its derivative, $\frac{n}{2}\paren{\varpar}^{-2}\paren{\hvarpar_{\text{ML}} - \varpar}$,
has the sign of $\hvarpar_{\text{ML}} - \varpar$.
So $(\bar x, \hvarpar_{\text{ML}})$ is the global maximizer,
provided the $x_i$ are not all equal.

{{< slidebreak >}}

::: {#rem-gaussian-variance-precision}
#### Differentiating with respect to the variance or the precision

Differentiating with respect to $\varpar$ as a single variable,
rather than with respect to $\sdpar$, keeps the algebra short.
Replacing $\varpar$ with the precision $\precision \eqdef 1/\varpar$
and differentiating with respect to $\precision$
can be shorter still,
because $\precision$ enters the log-likelihood as
$\frac{n}{2}\log\precision - \frac{\precision}{2}\sumin (x_i - \mean)^2$.
By the invariance of maximum likelihood estimates,
$\hprecision_{\text{ML}} = 1/\hvarpar_{\text{ML}}$.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

::: {#rem-gaussian-mle-sigma-bias}
#### The Gaussian variance MLE is biased

This MLE divides by $n$,
so it is a biased estimator of $\varpar$
([bias of the divide-by-$n$ estimator](estimation.qmd#exm-biased-variance-mle)).
:::
